text: A white lab bench with an aluminium extrusion frame runs diagonally across the foreground, carrying two white plastic wash bottles. The left bottle lies on its side, tilted along the rail, with a green band around its neck and a red/orange angled spout cap fitted. The right bottle stands upright, with a blue band around its body and a red/orange spout cap fitted. Metal locating pins, screws and two printed square fiducial (AprilTag-style) markers are mounted on the frame surface; a pale disc and a grey cylinder sit near the right marker. Behind, a black weighted base with two vertical black posts stands on a grey floor beside a white wall, LED strip lighting, and further aluminium profiles.
